title: A JiT-Based Denoising Defense Method Against Adversarial Examples for Radio Signal Automatic Modulation Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.35084v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automatic modulation classification (AMC) of radio signals is a core technology for spectrum monitoring and electromagnetic situational awareness. Deep neural networks (DNNs) play an important role in this field owing to their powerful feature extraction capabilities and end-to-end learning paradigm. However, their vulnerability to adversarial attacks poses serious security challenges to practical deployment. Adversarial training, a common defense, has limitations including poor generalization across attack types and high training costs. Inspired by Just image Transformers (JiT), a diffusion generative model that directly predicts clean images, this paper proposes a JiT-based denoising defense against adversarial examples for radio signal modulation classification. translated_title: 基于JiT的去噪防御方法：抵御对抗样本攻击的无线电信号自动调制分类
translated_abstract: 无线电信号的自动调制分类（AMC）是频谱监测和电磁态势感知的核心技术。深度神经网络（DNN）凭借其强大的特征提取能力和端到端学习范式在该领域发挥着重要作用。然而，DNN对对抗攻击的脆弱性给实际部署带来了严重的安全挑战。对抗训练作为一种常见的防御手段，存在跨攻击类型泛化能力差和训练成本高等局限性。受Just image Transformers（JiT）——一种直接预测干净图像的扩散生成模型——的启发，本文提出了一种基于JiT的去噪防御方法，用于抵御针对无线电信号调制分类的对抗样本攻击。在训练过程中，通过流匹配（flow matching）优化一种针对信号特性设计的一维Transformer去噪网络，直接预测干净的信号样本，从而学习一个映射...
tldr: 本文受JiT扩散生成模型启发，提出一种通过流匹配训练的信号专用一维Transformer去噪网络，直接将对抗样本还原为干净信号，从而提升无线电信号自动调制分类系统对抗对抗攻击的防御能力。
en_tdlr: Inspired by the JiT diffusion generative model, this paper proposes a signal-specific 1D Transformer denoising network trained via flow matching to directly predict clean signal samples, providing an effective denoising defense against adversarial examples in radio signal automatic modulation classification.
